title: The Plausibility Trap
tagline: Why video that looks perfect can still teach a robot the wrong physics
description: Two vendors, one pilot budget, and two headline numbers that measure different things. Walk out able to write an acceptance gate a vendor can actually fail.

title: Betting on Light
tagline: Take a million-times speed claim apart before you fund it: which half is physics, which half is an assumption, and what would kill the bet.
description: Split a headline speed claim into the half that is physics and the half that is an assumption about your workload, then write a funding memo with a kill criterion.
